text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the installation of speed bumps in laneway west of Royal York Road, between Melrose Street and Hay Avenue.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of speed bumps in the laneway first west of Royal York Road, between Melrose Street and Hay Avenue at the locations shown on Attachment 1 to the report (October 9, 2024) from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
